environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a Kubernetes cluster behind a basic L4 TCP load balancer (AWS NLB in TCP mode). Service is directly reachable on port 8080 from any pod in the cluster or via the NLB's public endpoint. No ingress controller, no TLS termination at the load balancer level. The RSA public key at /etc/app/keys/rsa_public.pem is a standard 2048-bit RSA public key mounted from a ConfigMap.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, port 443->8080 passthrough
config.tls: none at LB, application handles plaintext HTTP
